name: fix111_dig
verifies: fix-111: digging up a treasure spot (UseType PirateTreasure, G3 PS_Interact case 87 + PS_Interact_PirateTreasure). Without It_Shovel: HUD_MissingItem_Interact + FO_It_Shovel, no motion, nothing generated. With it: the hero walks to the spot, holds the shovel in the left hand and plays Hero_Stand_Staff_None_P0_DigGround Begin + Loop for the 10 s _AI_Action command time (fix-139: ~4 digs, 10 % Ambient per cycle; no End motion exists), the plunder is generated once from TS_Treasure_Pirate (4-5 stacks) and the loot page opens. Closed without taking, the spot keeps its stacks (dug again: the same stacks, no new roll) through a save/load; emptied, a dig says NothingToGet and stays so after a save/load
steps: log fix-150: the Gotha catacomb grave (stone mound + helmeted stake G3_Object_Grave_Cross_02 at 339.27,69.33,514.89) is decoration in G3, its loot is the unlocked chest beside it
notes: The Faring spot (595, 46, 578 m) is the nearest G3_Object_Interact_PirateTreasure_01 to the dev start; 23 spots in the world (12 PirateTreasure_01, 11 Treasure_Spot_01, mostly Varant). G3 changes nothing on the spot after digging (same mesh; no fame, spawn or crime of its own; the loot itself counts as a theft only where a seen take from a container would). Each dig sets the object's UseFunc as a game event (none of the 23 has one). The dig takes ~11-13 s (DigGround cycles while the state time is within 10 s of the loop start, fix-139; the shovel_push / swing sounds of the motion track). Unit tests: ObjectUseTests.Treasure_*. fix-150: graves are no dig spots in G3 (all 232 G3_Object_Grave_* are CStat static meshes without gCInteraction_PS; Script_Game has no grave code); the Gotha catacomb grave the owner tried to dig hides nothing, the loot there is the unlocked chest 8605bce9 (TS_Treasure_Small) 1.5 m away, see GraveDigImportTests. fix-184 (regress-1021b): spotloot counts distinct stacks and a plunder roll picks stacks with repeats (13 items in 3 stacks with seed 1), so >=1; at the Gotha chest the hero kneels in its open loop while the loot page is open (using=True) and stands up after closepage.
